title: General Motors, LLC: FUEL:FUEL LINES:HOSES:NON-METALLIC (6,807 affected)
summary: THE FUEL LINES ON THESE VEHICLES MAY HAVE BEEN MISROUTED AND MAY CONTACT THE "AIR" CHECK VALVE. THE HIGH TEMPERATURES FROM THE "AIR" CHECK VALVE COULD ALLOW IT TO MELT THROUGH AND DAMAGE A FUEL LINE.

title: redundant PREVOST CAR, INC. Inactive: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:BATTERY:CABLE (189 affected)
summary: BATTERY CABLE MAY CHAFE AGAINST THE BATTERY RACK DAMAGING THE CABLE'S INSULATION WHICH COULD RESULT IN AN ELECTRICAL SHORT.

title: AUTOFLUG S.A.: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AN (12,733 affected)
summary: WHEN USED WITH THE REAR SOFA SEATS, THE SEAT BELT BUCKLES CAN FAIL. THIS DOES NOT CONFORM TO THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 207, "SEATING SYSTEMS," AND FMVSS NO. 210, "SEAT BELT ASSEMBLY ANCHORAGES."

title: INTERNATIONAL TRUCK & ENGINE CORPORATION: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL (1,050 affected)
summary: THE HAND THROTTLE CABLE MAY BE MIS-ALIGNED WITH THE ACCELERATOR ROD CAUSING THE HAND THROTTLE CABLE TO "SAW" INTO THE ACCELERATOR ROD. THIS CAN CAUSE THE ACCELERATOR AND HAND THROTTLE CABLE TO BIND IN A PARTIAL OR FULL THROTTLE POSITION.

title: Volvo Trucks North America: VISUAL SYSTEMS:WINDSHIELD WIPER AND WASHER (74 affected)
summary: THE INDICATOR FOR THE INTERMITTENT WINDSHIELD WIPER CONTROL ON THE VEHICLE DASHBOARD DOES NOT ILLUMINATE WHEN THE HEADLIGHTS ARE ACTIVATED.

title: Volvo Trucks North America: FUEL:FUEL PUMP (1,356 affected)
summary: THE FUEL RACK WITHIN BOSCH INJECTION PUMPS MAY FAIL AND SEPARATE FROM THE ACTUATOR.

title: FREIGHTLINER LLC: POWER TRAIN:DRIVELINE:UNIVERSAL JOINT (11,000 affected)
summary: THE DRIVELINE U-JOINTS EXHIBIT EXCESSIVE RATES OF FAILURE AT LOW MILEAGES AND MAY CAUSE SEPARATION OF THE INTERAXLE DRIVELINE.

title: Blue Bird Body Company: STEERING:POWER ASSIST:HOSE:FLUID (259 affected)
summary: THE HYDRAULIC HOSES WHICH INTERCONNECT WITH THE HYDRAULIC PUMP, HYDRAULIC RADIATOR FAN MOTOR AND POWER STEERING GEAR HAVE AN UNDERSIZED WIRE MESH CORE WHICH RESULTS IN AN IMPROPER HOSE END CRIMP. THE IMPROPER CRIMP CAN CAUSE A LEAK, EMPTYING THE POWER STEERING HYDRAULIC FLUID RESERVOIR, RESULTING IN LOSS OF POWER STEERING ASSIST.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): FUEL:FUEL PUMP (35,000 affected)
summary: BOSCH DISTRIBUTOR-TYPE FUEL PUMPS HAVE A MANUFACTURING DEFECT THAT CAN CAUSE THE BALL PIN, WHICH IS PART OF THE PUMP'S CONTROL LEVER ASSEMBLY, TO BREAK CAUSING THE LINK BETWEEN THE CONTROL SLEEVE AND THE CONTROL LEVER TO BECOME INOPERATIVE.

title: Porsche Cars North America, Inc.: HEATER:WATER:DEFROSTER:DEFOGGER:CIRCUIT BREAKER FU (11,346 affected)
summary: AFTER THE ENGINE HAS BEEN TURNED OFF, THE REAR HEATER WILL AUTOMATICALLY OPERATE IN ORDER TO DISSIPATE HEAT IN THE ENGINE HEATING SYSTEM. DURING THIS OPERATION, THE RESISTOR FOR THE REAR HEATER BLOWER CAN BECOME OVERLOADED DUE TO A BINDING OR SEIZED REAR HEATER BLOWER.

title: Porsche Cars North America, Inc.: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:POWER ASSIST:CHECK VALVE (1,149 affected)
summary: THE HYDRAULIC BRAKE PRESSURE REDUCTION VALVE CAUSES THE RATE OF HYDRAULIC PRESSURE REDUCTION TO SLOW DOWN, WHICH MAY RESULT IN THE REAR WHEELS LOCKING-UP EVEN WITH THE ANTI-LOCK BRAKE SYSTEM IN OPERATION.

title: FAIRMONT TAMPER: STRUCTURE:FRAME:MEMBERS AND BODY (382 affected)
summary: CRACKS CAN DEVELOP IN THE VEHICLE FRAME NEAR THE LOCATION WHERE THE FRONT WHEEL UNIT MOUNTING BRACKETS ATTACH TO THE VEHICLE. CRACKS WILL CONTINUE TO INCREASE TO THE POINT WHERE THE UNIT BREAKS AT THE MOUNTING BRACKET ALLOWING THE WHEEL UNIT TO BECOME DETACHED FROM THE VEHICLE FRAME.

title: WESTERN STAR TRUCKS, INC.: STRUCTURE:BODY:ENTRY STEP:RUNNING BOARD (5,304 affected)
summary: THE CAB ACCESS GRAB HANDLES HAVE THINNER THAN SPECIFIED WALL THICKNESS AND ARE SUSCEPTIBLE TO FATIGUE FAILURE BREAKING AT THE BEND RADIUS NEAR THE UPPER MOUNTING BOLT HOLE.

title: CHANCE COACH, INC.: EQUIPMENT:WHEEL CHAIR LIFT (222 affected)
summary: THE VEHICLE OPERATORS ARE NOT AWARE THAT THE WHEELCHAIR HYDRAULIC SYSTEM NEEDS TO BE CYCLED ON A DAILY BASIS TO INSURE THAT THE PRESSURE REQUIRED TO HOLD IT IN THE STOWED POSITION HAS NOT BLED OFF. IF THE HYDRAULIC PRESSURE IS NOT SUFFICIENT TO HOLD THE PLATFORM IN THE STOWED POSITION AND THE VEHICLE MAKES A LEFT TURN, THE LIFT CAN MOVE. THE MOVEMENT CAUSES THE BRAKE INTERLOCK TO ACTIVATE, ABRUPTLY STOPPING THE VEHICLE.

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): INTERIOR SYSTEMS:PASSIVE RESTRAINT:AIR BAG:PASSENG (31 affected)
summary: THE PASSENGER-SIDE AIR BAG MODULES CONTAIN INCORRECT INFLATORS WHICH ARE OUT OF SPECIFICATION FOR THE PASSENGER SIDE AIR BAG.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): STEERING:COLUMN SHAFT UPPER (115,000 affected)
summary: THE MOLDED PLASTIC PIN WHICH CONNECTS THE UPPER STEERING COLUMN SHAFT AND THE LOWER COLUMN SHAFT MAY HAVE BEEN SHEARED PRIOR TO INSTALLATION OF THE STEERING COLUMN ASSEMBLY INTO THE VEHICLE. IF THIS OCCURRED, THE UPPER STEERING SHAFT WILL SEPARATE FROM THE LOWER STEERING SHAFT.

title: Harley-Davidson Motor Company: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL/MOTORCYCLE (4,038 affected)
summary: THE COMPONENTS WITHIN THE RIGHT-HAND SWITCH ASSEMBLY MAY GENERATE HEAT, WHICH IS CONDUCTED BY THE METAL THROTTLE GUIDE TUBES, SUFFICIENT TO MELT THE INTERLINER BETWEEN THE CABLE HOUSING AND THE THROTTLE CABLE, THUS RESTRICTING THE MOVEMENT OF THE THROTTLE CABLE.

title: General Motors, LLC: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT BELTS:LAP:REAR (1,238 affected)
summary: THE SAFETY BELT RETRACTORS FOR THE REAR CENTER POSITION ARE MISSING A PAWL SPRING AND IN CASE OF AN ACCIDENT, WILL ALLOW THE SAFETY BELT WEBBING TO EXTEND BEYOND THE MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 208, "OCCUPANT CRASH PROTECTION."

title: IC CORPORATION: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL (1,725 affected)
summary: THE HAND THROTTLE CABLE MAY BE MIS-ALIGNED WITH THE ACCELERATOR ROD CAUSING THE HAND THROTTLE CABLE TO "SAW" INTO THE ACCELERATOR ROD. THIS CAN CAUSE THE ACCELERATOR AND HAND THROTTLE CABLE TO BIND IN A PARTIAL OR FULL THROTTLE POSITION.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT LATCH (17,000 affected)
summary: THE SEAT BACK LATCH LEVER PIVOT RIVETS ARE SUSCEPTIBLE TO DISTORTION. THE DISTORTED ASSEMBLIES ALLOW THE SEAT BACK RELEASE LATCH LEVER TO REMAIN IN THE RELEASED POSITION WHICH IS IN NON-COMPLIANCE WITH FMVSS NO. 207, "SEATING SYSTEMS."

title: General Motors, LLC: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC SYSTEM (128 affected)
summary: THE FRONT LEFT BRAKE PIPE CHAFES AGAINST THE POWER STEERING HOSE WHICH WEARS A HOLE IN THE BRAKE PIPE. THIS CAUSES  A POTENTIAL LOSS OF BRAKE FLUID RESULTING IN LOSS OF FRONT BRAKE SYSTEM OPERATIONS.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): WHEELS:LUGS:NUTS:BOLTS (90 affected)
summary: WHEELS WITH MISFORMED LUG NUT SEATS WERE INSTALLED ON THESE VEHICLES. THIS CAUSES REDUCED NUT TO WHEEL CONTACT AREA AND LIMITS THE WHEEL SELF-CENTERING CAPABILITY DURING INSTALLATION. THIS RESULTS IN LOSS OF WHEEL LUG NUT TORQUE RETENTION.

title: General Motors, LLC: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT TRACK ANCHORS AND SEATS (1,375 affected)
summary: THE SEATS HAVE BEEN ASSEMBLED WITHOUT BOLTS THAT CONNECT THE UPPER SLAVE HINGE TO THE SEAT BACK FRAME, OR WITHOUT BOLTS THAT CONNECT THE SEAT TO THE SEAT ADJUSTER. IN EITHER CASE, THE VEHICLES FAIL TO CONFORM TO FNVSS NO. 207, "SEATING SYSTEMS."

title: BUS INDUSTRIES OF AMERICA: VISUAL SYSTEMS:MIRRORS (45 affected)
summary: THE LEFT HAND REARVIEW MIRROR CAN BE ADJUSTED TO A POSITION WHICH INTERFERES WITH THE OPENING OF THE EMERGENCY EXIT WINDOW LOCATED ADJACENT TO THE DRIVER POSITION. IN SUCH CASES, THE VEHICLE IS IN NON-COMPLIANCE WITH FMVSS NO. 217, "BUS WINDOW RETENTION AND RELEASE."

title: CENTURY PRODUCTS: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT (78,000 affected)
summary: SOME RED BUTTONS SHIPPED TO REPAIR BUCKLE RELEASE BUTTONS RECALLED UNDER NHTSA CAMPAIGN NO. 92E017000 MAY HAVE BEEN INCORRECT.

title: FRUEHAUF CORPORATION: STRUCTURE:FRAME:MEMBERS AND BODY (49 affected)
summary: WELDS ARE MISSING ON THE REAR CHASSIS CROSSMEMBER TO THE CHASSIS CENTERBEAM, TO WHICH A HITCH FOR TOWING ANOTHER DUMP TRAILER IS ATTACHED.

title: Kawasaki Motors Corp., U.S.A.: ENGINE (8,817 affected)
summary: THE HEX NUT WHICH SECURES THE DRIVE CHAIN SPROCKET TO THE TRANSMISSION OUTPUT SHAFT MAY BECOME LOOSE.

title: Winnebago Industries, Inc.: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:TANK (11,353 affected)
summary: FUEL TANKS LEAK AT THE SEAMS AND/OR BAFFLE CONNECTIONS.

title: WALTCO TRUCK EQUIPMENT CO: STRUCTURE:TAILGATE ASSEMBLY (4,000 affected)
summary: THE LIFTGATE ASSEMBLY MAY EXPERIENCE SEVERAL TYPES OF FAILURE; 1) THE HYDRAULIC HOSES MAY LEAK OR SEPARATE FROM THE FITTING AT THE SWAGED END OF THE FITTING ON ALL MODELS, 2) IF PROPER PROCEDURES FOR STORING THE BZ AND RZ LIFTGATES FOR TRANSIT ARE NOT FOLLOWED, THE LIFT CYLINDER CLEVISES MAY BREAK AS A RESULT OF ROAD VIBRATION AND CAUSE THE CLEVIS TO UNSCREW; AND 3) IF PROPER PROCEDURES ARE NOT FOLLOWED FOR STORING THE BZ AND RZ LIFTGATES, THE LIFTGATES CAN COME IN CONTACT WITH THE CYLINDER CLEVISES, WHICH CAN BREAK THE CLEVIS OFF OF THE CYLINDER SHAFT.

title: WHITE RIVER MARINE GROUP LLC: STRUCTURE:BODY:GRAB BAR:STRAP MOUNTING ASSIST (777 affected)
summary: THE HANDRAIL FOR THE STEPS LOCATED ON THE WINCH STAND MAY NOT BE OF SUFFICIENT STRENGTH TO SUPPORT THE FORCE APPLIED BY A USER OF THE HANDRAIL CAUSING IT TO BREAK.
